scope: Bounded currently accessible project recovery surfaces; historical recovery and artistic acceptance remain open

definitions.object: One complete byte string identified by its full SHA-256 and byte count. Revisions with different hashes remain separate.
definitions.file_occurrence: One recovered file location, branch-tip path, source-site path, or container-SHA/member-path pair; multiple receipt rows for the same occurrence are merged.
definitions.archive_member: An independently hashed byte string contained in a verified outer archive. Member bytes and outer archive bytes are separately counted, so totals are not disk usage.
definitions.code: Preserved code file bytes. Their existence does not prove executable dependencies, deterministic rendering, or artistic acceptance.
definitions.original_source: User-supplied screenplay or source video identity retained unchanged and joined by exact SHA-256.
definitions.reference_record: A textual citation or checksum assertion from a report/code/document. References never inflate the recovered-object denominator.
definitions.name_candidate: Potential filename/normalized-label match, never a byte-identity resolution.
definitions.archive_crc: Successful ZIP container/member integrity checks can coexist with intrinsically incomplete or damaged media members.
definitions.acceptance: Preservation, full decode, browser playback, reproducible rendering, and artistic acceptance are separate gates.
